summary: Full all-ℓ weighted target is precise and open-supported. Inspected prior theorems do not settle the family; Theorem 12 covers lengths 4, 8, 12 but its criterion fails at 16. New exact diagnostics support a concrete global operator route, without proving it or establishing novelty.
next_test: Independently prove or refute the arbitrary-dimensional lemma ||(uuᵀ/2+B)²||op≥1/4 via identity (R), and test whether a verified primary operator theorem already implies it.
